# Tough security   built for tough jobs.

CompanyCam’s expert-verified security is designed to safeguard project photos and sensitive data.

[View Trust Center](https://trust.companycam.com/)

![SOC 2 Type II certified security](https://companycam.imgix.net/images/trust-center/icons/soc2.png)![GDPR compliant data protection](https://companycam.imgix.net/images/trust-center/icons/gdpr.png)![CCPA compliant privacy standards](https://companycam.imgix.net/images/trust-center/icons/ccpa.png)![Data Privacy Framework certified](https://companycam.imgix.net/images/trust-center/icons/DPF.png)

## Enterprise-Grade Security

### Built to Protect

Security isn’t just an add-on—it’s how we’re built. CompanyCam is SOC 2 Type II certified, GDPR and CCPA compliant, and undergoes annual third-party penetration testing. Our vendor management program ensures every partner in our ecosystem meets the same rigorous standards.

#### Certifications and Standards

- SOC 2 Type II certified
- GDPR & CCPA Compliant
- Annual third-party penetration test
- Vendor security reviews across all integrations

### Your Data, Your Control

We protect what matters most—your photos, documents, and project details. Your data is encrypted at rest and in transit, hosted exclusively on US-based AWS servers, and accessible only to authorized users.

#### Data Protection

- Encryption at rest and in transit
- Hosted on AWS infrastructure inside the United States
- Strict access controls and permissions
- Data never shared without business consent
- Document data download and retention policies

### Reliability and Transparency

You need security that works as hard as you do. Our infrastructure is monitored 24/7 for performance, and uptime history is publicly available. Transparency is part of our commitment to building trust.

[View Status Center](https://status.companycam.com/?_gl=1*1tj1iz1*_gcl_au*MTAxODQ4ODc3MS4xNzYxMjM1OTQzLjExNzMzMzUxNjUuMTc2MzQ4MjE5Ny4xNzYzNDgyMTk2*_ga*MTUxMTc4MjQ4MC4xNzYxMjM1OTQz*_ga_J48HTRJMG3*czE3NjQ2OTQxMjkkbzEwMyRnMSR0MTc2NDY5NDI2MyRqNTkkbDAkaDU0ODU5MDQ3Mw..*_ga_9EHVFEZKVX*czE3NjQ2OTQxMjkkbzExMSRnMSR0MTc2NDY5NDI2MyRqNTkkbDAkaDExMjk5ODQ3OTE)

#### Monitoring and Tracking

- Continuous monitoring and alerting
- Real-time infrastructure monitoring
- Public status and incident history

![Enterprise security features and compliance monitoring](https://companycam.imgix.net/images/trust-center/icons/shield.png)

## See security up close

Need the technical breakdown? Check out detailed security documentation, security FAQs, and the latest compliance reports.

[View Trust Center](https://trust.companycam.com/)

## Security FAQ

- [**Is CompanyCam SOC 2 Type II certified?**](https://companycam.com/trust-center#question-1)


Yes. CompanyCam maintains active SOC 2 Type II certification, verified through annual third-party audits.

- [**Where is CompanyCam data stored?**](https://companycam.com/trust-center#question-2)


All data is hosted on US-based AWS infrastructure, encrypted at rest and in transit.

- [**Does CompanyCam comply with GDPR and CCPA?**](https://companycam.com/trust-center#question-3)


Yes. CompanyCam complies with GDPR and CCPA, ensuring users can access, delete, or control their data as required by law.

- [**Does CompanyCam perform regular security testing?**](https://companycam.com/trust-center#question-4)


Yes. Our systems undergo annual penetration testing and continuous internal reviews to identify and resolve potential vulnerabilities.
